mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.u_idx=u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx

SELECT r.r_idx AS res_idx, r.s_idx AS spc_idx, r.u_idx AS user_idx, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_end_time, r.r_content AS res_content, r.r_headcount AS res_headcount, r.r_total_price AS res_total_price, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_created, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_updated,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_updated, r.r_status AS res_status, u.u_name AS user_name, u.u_email AS user_email, u.u_phone AS user_phone, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, b.b_name AS brn_name FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.u_idx=u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx=b.b_idx
ORDER BY r.r_created DESC LIMIT #{numPerPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.r_idx AS res_idx, r.s_idx AS spc_idx, r.u_idx AS user_idx, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_end_time, r.r_content AS res_content, r.r_headcount AS res_headcount, r.r_total_price AS res_total_price, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_created, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_updated,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_updated, r.r_status AS res_status, CONCAT('R-', DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created,'%Y%m%d'), '-', LPAD(r.r_idx,4,'0')) AS res_code, u.u_name AS user_name, u.u_email AS user_email, u.u_phone AS user_phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r2 WHERE r2.u_idx=u.u_idx) AS user_res_cnt, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, b.b_name AS brn_name, v.v_idx AS rev_idx, v.v_rating AS rev_rating, v.v_content AS rev_content, DATE_FORMAT(v.v_created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS rev_created_at, v.v_active AS rev_active, v.v_img AS rev_img FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.u_idx=u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx=b.b_idx LEFT JOIN review v ON v.v_idx=( SELECT v2.v_idx FROM review v2 WHERE v2.u_idx=r.u_idx AND v2.s_idx=r.s_idx AND v2.v_parent_idx=0 ORDER BY v2.v_created_at DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE r.r_idx=#{resIdx}

SELECT r.r_idx AS res_idx, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_end_time, r.r_status AS res_status, r.r_total_price AS res_total_price, CONCAT('R-', DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created,'%Y%m%d'), '-', LPAD(r.r_idx,4,'0')) AS res_code, s.s_name AS spc_name, b.b_name AS brn_name FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx=b.b_idx WHERE r.u_idx=#{userIdx} AND r.r_idx != #{resIdx} ORDER BY r.r_created DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT s_idx AS spc_idx, s_name AS spc_name FROM space ORDER BY s_name ASC

SELECT r.r_status AS res_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.u_idx=u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx
GROUP BY r.r_status
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET r_status='CONFIRMED', r_updated=NOW() WHERE r_idx=#{resIdx} AND r_status='PENDING'
UPDATE reservation SET r_status='COMPLETED', r_updated=NOW() WHERE r_idx=#{resIdx} AND r_status IN ('CONFIRMED','USING')
UPDATE reservation SET r_status='CANCELLED', r_content=#{cancelReason}, r_updated=NOW() WHERE r_idx=#{resIdx} AND r_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','COMPLETED')
